name: stale-canonical-functional-planner
purpose: Provide a deterministic functional planning seam for one existing LakatoTree engine command without inventing a second lifecycle authority.
rationale: The command already belongs to the LakatoTree judgement engine and has one application-service consumer.
The extracted logic owns classification and receipt planning but no independent durable state, scheduler, recovery loop, or effect dispatcher.
A narrow module is sufficient and avoids premature command-event machinery.

boundary.owns: Ordered stale-head classification, operator-lock partitioning, public response projection, and deterministic demotion receipt planning.
boundary.mechanism: Transform immutable canonical-head observations, effective floor, dry-run mode, captured timestamp, and engine identity into frozen plans.
policy_outside: Clock capture, KG CAS, and history projection
non_goals: Creating a new runtime or persistence authority
boundary.state_authority: The existing Neo4j canonical head and writer-fenced JudgementService transaction remain authoritative.

invariants: Only valid_until_rebutted equal to false is locked.
Public candidates never expose the expected previous receipt head.
Injected effect drafts are validated before predecessor projection, then every selected live receipt uses the one timestamp captured after all predecessor projections.
Injected decisions and effect drafts may suppress only an ordered subset and cannot invent, unlock, reorder, or forge effects.
The guarded mutation rechecks both the observed receipt head and operator-lock value.
The planner imports no effect layer.
failure_model: A dry-run decision cannot produce demotion effects.
A receipt-head or operator-lock CAS miss remains a skipped demotion with no history projection.
Receipt hashing continues through the existing versioned receipt authority.
verification: Mutable-floor, forged decision, forged or reordered draft, receipt-head race, and operator-lock race negative oracles.
JP1 receipt and legacy hash regression.
promotion_gates: A second independent consumer needs the same durable state authority.
The module gains an independent command/event lifecycle and recovery responsibility.
Operational evidence shows a scheduler or effect dispatcher cannot remain in the parent engine.
falsifiers: If classification cannot remain deterministic from captured observations, return it to the application service.
If the module begins owning clocks, databases, files, or history, the boundary has failed.
